title: Edlink LMS–Assisted Blended Learning: Its Impact on Students’ Physics Conceptual Understanding and Self-Regulated Learning
reason: Single-group pretest-posttest comparison of a conceptual test and a self-report SRL questionnaire; no Edlink LMS activity measure enters any analysis.

extraction.n_quote: The sample consisted of 32 students from one intact class.
extraction.lms_indicators: none (Edlink LMS used for delivery only)
extraction.outcome_or_construct: four-tier diagnostic test (conceptual understanding); SRL questionnaire
extraction.notes: Secondary NOREL: SRL is self-report and only compared pre/post. N-Gain 0.65 and 0.66 are pre-post gains, not indicator-outcome relations.
